summary: Firefox made navigation and page loading more robust, including retrying HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 requests after an unclean shutdown and applying navigation rate limits consistently. It also strengthened browser-side checks for sandboxed window closing, service-worker state, and process-specific origins, while ensuring only the parent process controls certain DevTools and browsing-context state. MathML links gained familiar link attributes, and pages accessed through the back-forward cache now retain DevTools tracking more reliably.
